question: When did Mike Petrusky end the Asset Champion Podcast and how many combined episodes had it produced?
transcript_excerpt: After more than 600 combined episodes across both the Workplace Innovator podcast and the Asset Champion podcast, Mike Petrusky announced the conclusion of both shows after almost nine years at Aptura. The last episode of the Asset Champion podcast, episode 185, was published and featured Alana Dunoff discussing IFMA's World Workplace.

question: What is the final episode of the Workplace Innovator podcast featuring and when will it be released?
transcript_excerpt: The very final new podcast episode of the Workplace Innovator will feature Kay Sargent of HOK, who has been on the show more than any other guest. This final episode will be published next week and will focus on reminiscing about the past 10 years and looking forward to the next decade.

question: What role did Elizabeth Dukes of iOffice play in launching Mike Petrusky's podcast career?
transcript_excerpt: In March 2018, Elizabeth Dukes, co-founder of iOffice, hired Mike Petrusky and added him to her marketing team, which set the foundation for his entire podcast journey. Petrusky credits this decision as the catalyst that made his 10-year run in facility management media and thought leadership possible.

question: Where will Mike Petrusky present with Aaron Savitz at IFMA's World Workplace and what are the session topics?
